dedupe_keys.name: natural gas and oil reserves on the dutch territory national accounts

description: Natural gas and oil reserves on the Dutch territory; national accounts is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CBS OpenData. (Physical) natural gas and oil reserves consist of the quantities of natural gas and oil found in the Netherlands that are proven and commercially and socially viable to extract, plus quantities where future extraction is considered likely. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher CBS OpenData. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ATOM, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
